protective_measures: public summaries omit host account and endpoint details
subject_locator_policy: collect only locator class and emergency reachability token until counsel or ombud authorizes further detail
worker_safety: staff use hardened accounts and do not engage alleged steward from personal channels
retaliation_response: immediate sealed incident report, non-retaliation notice, and safe-handoff to authority if steward contact produces adverse action
data_minimization: intake form separates public shell from sealed locator and mental-content fields; mental-content details are discouraged unless necessary for immediate protection
public_summary: Hotline field plan protects vulnerable reporters and subjects while permitting emergency triage and preservation.
